state.description: Whether the list has it, leading there: `listed`, or `not_listed`.

file.description:
The file it's declared in, from the project root, as `ascribe check`
reports it.

line.description: The line of its `@id` or its frontmatter `permalink`, from 1.

listed_at.description: The place the list has for it, when that's somewhere else.

place.description:
Where it's declared, as the list writes it: the file's path from the
content root, and `#` and the id for a heading.

state.description:
Whether the list has it: `listed` at one of the places its name is
declared, `moved` when the list has it somewhere else, or
`not_listed`.

ListState.description: Whether the list has a permalink where it's declared.

oneOf.description: At one of the places its name is declared.
At a place that doesn't declare it any more.

ListedAs.description: Which of the list's tables has a name.

RemovedEntry.description: A name the list has that the project doesn't.

place.description:
Where the list says a permalink was declared; for an alias, the name
it led to; for a retired permalink, its reason.

was.description: What the list has it as.

state.description:
Whether the list has it as retired, with this reason: `listed`, or
`not_listed`.

to.description:
Where its address leads now, as written: a page, and `#` and a
heading's id.

aliases.description: The aliases `ascribe.toml` declares, in declaration order.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

has_list.description:
Whether the project has `ascribe.permalinks`. Without it, every
permalink is `not_listed`, and nothing is `removed`.

permalinks.description:
Every permalink the content declares, in path order and then in
document order, a page's own first. A name declared in several
places is here once for each.

removed.description: The names the list has that the project no longer has, by name.

retired.description: The permalinks `ascribe.toml` retires, in declaration order.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.
